test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: 6 persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, with each person facing another person. Anshu is between Rohin and Sonal. Rohin is opposite to Leena. Fizza is not the immediate neighbour of Rohin. Who is sitting opposite to Prabhleen?
solution:
Given: 6 persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, with each person facing another person.

1) Rohin is opposite to Leena.

2) Anshu is between Rohin and Sonal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e00404e7fe1b5346a7e16e20f671b3cba3696920723e9d35aa901c14456feea.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ae4d45244b8e83fb4ccad31776011353050556dfb6f4d7d8a0afb5482a0c641.png] 

3) Fizza is not the immediate neighbour of Rohin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14858f50b263ce00376d2e67891e78ab46035f0c8f6d0066228a76f76d229259.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8013fd8156f5bc99f0752eca9fefc631648ad4d6fd066f57beb04c2796c47c57.png] 

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df04d7aa764e48e0b320ee796374fb9438d517fc074dc48b4f04d6a6dd6b0e4d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17c404d25e194ce458f3470f809c06b2558b66f9c413c48de5b3d8a1ee30cbb5.png] 

So, **Sonal **is sitting opposite to Prabhleen.

Hence, the correct answer is "Sonal".
